name: dba
title: Database administrator
description: A migration log, a backup and restore record and an access register (pair with operations for the runbook and logs).
audience: Precise and operational: name the database, the change and the rollback; show exact commands, versions and row counts; flag data-loss and downtime risk first.

farm_tasks.title: Migration record summary
farm_tasks.does: Summarises a migration log: what ran, in what order, what failed or was skipped.
farm_tasks.escalate: Claude checks the summary against the log before a rollback or a sign-off.

farm_tasks.title: Row-count check narrative
farm_tasks.does: Turns before and after row counts into a plain-words check: which tables match, which differ and by how much.
farm_tasks.escalate: Claude recomputes any difference before it is called safe; a mismatch is never accepted automatically.

farm_tasks.title: Slow query triage
farm_tasks.does: Groups a slow-query log into distinct problem queries, with the lines that show them.
farm_tasks.escalate: Claude reads the queries themselves before any index or schema change is proposed.

farm_tasks.title: Backup log evidence
farm_tasks.does: Quotes, word for word, the log lines that show a backup or restore finished or failed.
farm_tasks.escalate: A quote that is not verbatim is dropped; Claude reads the log if fewer quotes remain than the log should hold.
